note: The larger of Yokum's Vacationland's two Seneca Rocks campgrounds, about 1 km north of the Rocks behind Yokum's restaurant along the North Fork of the South Branch Potomac, with a view of Seneca Rocks; RV hookup sites in a row along the river and around an open field, tent and electric pop-up sites, playground. Sister campground Princess Snowbird (id 14255) stays open all winter. Unrated on RV Life; Yokum's Vacationland Google 4.6 over 569 reviews. --Claude
